ga-1.title: Send only low-sensitivity data to overseas AI
ga-1.task: With AI services hosted overseas, use data up to Restricted and Sensitive Normal only.
ga-1.why: Data processed in another country carries more legal, privacy and leak risk.
ga-1.question: Will your app send data to an AI service hosted overseas, and is it no higher than Restricted and Sensitive Normal?

ga-2.title: Limit data sent to Singapore-hosted AI services
ga-2.task: With AI services hosted in Singapore, use data up to Confidential and Sensitive High only.
ga-2.why: Even in Singapore, data sent to an AI service can leak or be misused.
ga-2.question: Will your app send data to a Singapore-hosted AI service, and is it no higher than Confidential and Sensitive High?

ga-3.title: Get a no-logging, no-training agreement
ga-3.task: Get a legally binding commitment that the provider doesn't log, store or keep your inputs and outputs, and doesn't train on them (short-term prompt caching is allowed).
ga-3.why: Without it, the provider could read or reuse your data, including classified data.
ga-3.question: Do you have a legally binding no-logging, no-training agreement with the AI service provider?

ga-4.title: Host AI models where your data is allowed
ga-4.task: Host self-hosted AI models in an environment approved for the highest data classification the system holds.
ga-4.why: A model in a less secure environment than its data opens a path for attackers.
ga-4.question: If you host an AI model yourself, is the environment approved for the highest classification of data in your system?

ga-5.title: Use approved formats and loaders for AI models
ga-5.task: If you use open-weights models, use only approved model formats and approved loaders.
ga-5.why: Some model formats and loaders can run malicious code when loaded.
ga-5.question: Do you use open-weights AI models? If so, which formats and loaders are approved for you?

ga-6.title: Protect file uploads in AI features
ga-6.task: If users can upload files to your AI app, add safeguards for what they upload and what the model can reveal.
ga-6.why: Uploads can leak sensitive data or carry attacks aimed at the model.
ga-6.question: Can users upload files in your AI app, and what safeguards are planned?

ga-7.title: Test your AI's accuracy and safety
ga-7.task: Test the accuracy, safety and quality of outputs using clear measures, test scenarios and pass criteria.
ga-7.why: Untested AI can give wrong or harmful answers that people act on.
ga-7.question: Who tests your AI's outputs, and against what measures and scenarios?

ga-8.title: Make users acknowledge AI can be wrong
ga-8.task: Require users to explicitly agree, for example with a checkbox, that outputs can be inaccurate before they use the app.
ga-8.why: Users who aren't warned may trust made-up answers.
ga-8.question: Will users have to acknowledge the risk of inaccurate AI answers before using your app?
